infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sincère uses your camera once, for the liveness check that verifies you are a real person. The video is deleted after verification.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The liveness check records a short video with audio.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sincère reads your location only while the app is open, to find matches within your chosen radius. We never track you in the background and keep no location history.
